subject.title: fix(android): restore the complete Wear companion experience

question: Should OpenClaw ship agent selection, paired-phone Gateway connect/disconnect controls, and persistent Watch appearance/speech preferences as part of the Wear companion contract?
rationale: The patch is a broad user-facing expansion with compatibility-sensitive Phone/Watch protocol and session-state behavior; choosing that durable product contract is not a mechanical repair decision.

options.title: Approve the capability-gated companion contract
options.body: Accept the new controls and local preferences with the advertised-capability fallback and agent-scoped session behavior as the supported staggered-update model.

options.title: Narrow the release scope
options.body: Keep the existing chat, session, and Talk companion surface, and move agent/Gateway controls plus local settings into a separately sponsored proposal.

options.title: Pause for Android owner design review
options.body: Hold merge until the owner confirms the intended paired-device upgrade and session-selection contract across released Phone and Watch versions.

recommendation.title: Approve the capability-gated companion contract
recommendation.body: Accept the new controls and local preferences with the advertised-capability fallback and agent-scoped session behavior as the supported staggered-update model.

likelyOwner.reason: Steipete is assigned and authored the recent protocol, control-context, and agent-scoping hardening commits on the final branch.
